correctness.rationale: The exact orthogonal Laplacian eigenspace decomposition gives three entry classes. For every even degree, positivity and strict convexity of the scalar even Taylor polynomial make cross-part entries the sole sign constraint and prove a universal sharp root. For every odd degree, strict decay of odd Taylor polynomials and the positive-kernel interpolation representation imply exactly one permanent zero per potentially negative class, with the cubic case reducible to a minimum-part and singleton criterion. The analytic argument covers all sizes and orders. Independently constructed rational Laplacian powers and entry formulas agreed in 430,180 checks over 247 multipartite compositions; experiments are supporting, not infinity proofs.

value.rationale: This is a motivated complete classification of positivity thresholds for arbitrary order Taylor heat propagation on a natural, widely used unequal-degree graph family. Its even/odd structural dichotomy, sharp graph-independent RK4 timestep, all-order no-reentry theorem, and explicit cubic singleton/minimum-part criterion are substantively stronger than sample computations or a routine restatement of a general SSP bound.
